payload.value: macOS app is a Swift Package: DotsHarness executable composes DotsHarnessUI over DotsHarnessCore; RootView renders NavigationSplitView/ConversationView and AppModel coordinates state. AgentBridge is a UI-facing facade over @Observable NativeAgentHost; the host owns conversation/run state and streams provider deltas to UI, with ConversationStore persistence.
